2) Move the full technical portion to June 8th — same 11:00am PT slot; live, full 45m.

If Aurora needs all stakeholders in one synchronous window on the 3rd, option 1 keeps things on schedule while still preserving the live Q&A. I'm happy to prep the short recording and notes.
